basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer from Panama City, Panama. I love exploring new technologies and am a huge fan of e-bikes, which is why I spend a lot of time on subreddits like juicedbikes. I recently got into gaming and enjoy playing Deltarune and Royale High on Roblox. I’m also a lefty, which sometimes leads to hilarious mishaps that I share on LeftHandProblems. In my free time, I enjoy making memes and watching nostalgic shows like VeggieTales. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work and am currently single.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Graphic Design from a local university and have been working in the field for about 6 years. My interest in technology and e-bikes comes from a mix of self-teaching and personal experience. Gaming is a new hobby, and I’m learning through community discussions and trial and error.
